name: docusaurus
description: Docusaurus docs: .md and .mdx content, ATX '#' headers, static Markdown partial imports (import Foo from "./_foo.mdx", used as <Foo />) resolved within the project root. Relative and project-root-relative paths are supported; @site, @theme and custom aliases, package/code imports and unimported components are skipped. Configuration is not executed. Auto-detected from a docusaurus.config.js or docusaurus.config.ts file at or above content_dir.
